correctness.rationale: Exact arc contraction proves per-order joint edge probabilities; factorial-moment pattern analysis controls repeated arcs and overlapping order indices at critical scale. Exact second factorial moment gives concentration above the threshold. Fourfold arc counts and pair collision estimates give isolation; the formula is deterministically equivalent to a triple-hit arc. check.py exhaustively corroborates 1692 prescribed-arc cases and exact rational first/second moments over 347112 collections of orders (216+1296+13824+331776). These finite tests are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural input-dependent successor signature raises the mathematical question of when a 2-variable adjacency-overlap sentence becomes typically true. The exact cubic-root window and nontrivial 1-exp(-c^3/6) curve expose the first three-way overlap transition beyond fixed-pair phenomena; isolated rare witnesses make its local model structure explicit. Exact finite second moments support quantitative diagnostics for arbitrary numbers of traversals. It neither asserts fixed-signature zero-one laws nor solves satisfiability complexity; the result is a meaningful structural random-model boundary in its own right.
